scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to real even degree-two trigonometric polynomials sampled on cyclic grids with N>=5. The infinite family is proved symbolically; finite computation is corroborative only. Ivanov (2018) already covers the isolated moduli N=6,7,9 in equivalent notation; the claimed contribution is the single all-N formula, proof, equality criterion, and extremizer. A differently indexed equivalent all-N formula remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact degree-two discretized Carathéodory–Fejér constant on every cyclic grid
